title: DBB Application Configuration Variables
description: DBB Application configuration variables used in the orchestration of DBB builds to override build configuration variables.

version.description: The version of DBB application configuration schema being used for this configuration. This field does not validate anything when used inside of an IDE. It will only be validated at runtime.

name.description: Name of the application to override.

baseline.description: Reference to a previous build package of this application. Incremental builds use this to carry forward artifacts from unchanged files into the new build package, ensuring every build package is complete regardless of how many files were recompiled.

type.description: The artifact repository layout type used to locate the baseline build package. Use 'release' or 'snapshot' to pin to a specific reference, or 'last' to resolve automatically from the most recent successful build result.

reference.description: The version of the baseline build package to retrieve (e.g. '1.5.0'). Required when type is 'release' or 'snapshot'. Not used when type is 'last'.

repository.description: The label of the artifact repository where the baseline build package is stored.

buildid.description: Uses a specific build as a baseline. When omitted, the latest build package matching the type and reference is used. Not used when type is 'last'. (optional)

interfaces.description: Declares which source files and build outputs the Package task collects into this application's build package for consumption by other applications.

sources.description: Authored source files (e.g. copybooks) to publish in the build package. All source interfaces are public and are placed under /include/src/ in the package. Each entry is a glob pattern relative to the workspace root.

items.description: A glob pattern relative to the workspace root (e.g. '${APP_DIR_NAME}/copybook/*.cpy').

outputs.description: Build outputs (e.g. object decks, generated BMS copybooks) to publish in the build package. Inside the package, public outputs are placed under /include/bin/; private outputs under /lib/bin/.

description.description: A human-readable label for this output interface (e.g. 'shared objects').

usage.description: 'public' artifacts are available to other applications. 'private' artifacts are intended for internal use only.

deployTypes.description: The deploy types that identify which build outputs to include (e.g. OBJ, BMSCOPY, LOAD). Only outputs with a matching deploy type are packaged. The deploy type of the output will also be used as its file extension in the package.

items.description: A deploy type string as assigned in the language task (e.g. 'OBJ', 'LOAD', 'BMSCOPY').

buildFilePatterns.description: Glob patterns that select the input source files whose build outputs are packaged. The Package task looks up the build outputs produced from each matched source file.

items.description: A glob pattern relative to the workspace root (e.g. '${APP_DIR_NAME}/cobol/share/*.cbl').

include.description: Included files to merge into configuration.

imports.description: List of external build packages to import when building this application.

items.description: A single import entry pointing to an external build package.

name.description: The name of the imported build package.

type.description: The artifact repository layout type used to locate the import.

reference.description: The version reference of the build package (e.g. 1.2.0).

repository.description: The artifact repository the build package is stored in.

buildid.description: The build identifier of the build package artifact.

task.description: Name of an existing task to override

then.description: Rule that applies to a list of patterns

items.description: A glob file pattern for conditional matching

then.description: A glob file pattern for conditional matching

items.description: Properties provided to the current context

then.description: Rule that applies to a list of patterns

delimiter.description: The delimiter used when constructing append conditionals or appending lists to this value.

restricted.description: If true, this variable cannot be overridden by included files like the application configuration. Default: false

items.description: A condition and a value to associate with it.
A condition and a value to associate with it.

filePattern.description: A glob file pattern for conditional matching

eval.description: Conditional statement that will be evaluated by the JEXL Engine.

items.description: Conditional statement that will be evaluated by the JEXL Engine. All statements must evaluate to true.

exists.description: Condition is only true if the provided property exists. Evaluations are run after this step if it resolves to true.

items.description: Condition is only true if the all provided properties exist. Evaluations are run after this step if it resolves to true.

notExists.description: Condition is only true if the provided property does not exist. Evaluations are run after this step if it resolves to true.

items.description: Condition is only true if the all provided properties do not exist. Evaluations are run after this step if it resolves to true.
